title: Frames ContentOS Router Intent v1
description: Intent brief for source-to-video routing. Declares source_type, deliverable, route (Fase 3 workflow), and capability_map (Fase 2 skills). Route-once, route-by-deliverable.

source_type.description: Input source type. Drives capability_map (media resolve for url/footage/music).

source_ref.description: Source locator (URL, PR reference, text excerpt). No network fetch at route time.

deliverable.description: Requested deliverable (e.g. 'explain a GitHub PR', 'market a website'). Route-by-deliverable, not by keyword.

route.description: Fase 3 workflow that owns the deliverable end-to-end.

capability_map.description: Fase 2 capability skills the workflow loads on-demand. Never own the deliverable.

duration_s.description: Target deliverable duration in seconds. >180 routes to content-os-general-video.

runtime.description: Dual paradigm. html-gsap (Frames ContentOS) default. remotion only if intent explicitly requests.

offline.description: Router is offline-first. No network on route path.

workflow_status.description: Fase 3 workflow availability. pending = coverage_gap, dispatch capabilities only.
